digest.component_or_area: live jira dc harness test oracle
propositions: test assertion uses case-sensitive substring scan of json.dumps(ticket) against raw uppercase Jira key RBJNAZV-1, but the inbound path stores lowercased local id jira-rbjnazv-1, making the match impossible
ticket payload carries no raw Jira key; it appears only in title fallback when summary is absent, so correctly-created tickets with summaries fail the oracle's assertion
binding store maps local id to remote Jira key but list_tickets does not return bindings, so the oracle cannot verify the round-trip correspondence
the test must derive expected local id using _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key) and match on ticket.id exactly, then additionally assert the binding maps that local id to remote_key
this is the third oracle-that-cannot-pass pattern found in the epic; prior invisible failures were masked by earlier setup/abort defects
